rows.label: bf06140190_0010
rows.name: Are you already feeling well enough?

rows.label: bf06140190_0020
rows.name:
It's only been one day...
Please don't strain yourself.

rows.label: bf06140190_0030
rows.name:
Half a day off and look
at all this paperwork!

rows.label: bf06140190_0040
rows.name: Honestly... I can't even sleep in peace.

rows.label: bf06140190_0050
rows.name: Majesty...

rows.label: bf06140190_0060
rows.name: Special Commissioner, I have a new mission for you.

rows.label: bf06140190_0070
rows.name:
Continue as Superbia's envoy
and accompany Heaven's Holy Grail.

rows.label: bf06140190_0080
rows.name:
Serve as their guard so they
can reach Luxuria safely.

rows.label: bf06140190_0090
rows.name: Their guard...?

rows.label: bf06140190_0100
rows.name: I have His Holiness Malbeni's permission as well.

rows.label: bf06140190_0110
rows.name: With respect, I cannot accept that.

rows.label: bf06140190_0120
rows.name: There's also what happened yesterday.

rows.label: bf06140190_0130
rows.name: I cannot leave Your Majesty's side.

rows.label: bf06140190_0140
rows.name: Are those your true feelings?

rows.label: bf06140190_0150
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]え？

rows.label: bf06140190_0160
rows.name:
It's written on your face. You want to travel
with Heaven's Holy Grail...

rows.label: bf06140190_0170
rows.name: or rather, with that boy,

rows.label: bf06140190_0180
rows.name: That's not-!

rows.label: bf06140190_0190
rows.name:
I am the Special Commissioner.
My duty is to protect Your Majesty.

rows.label: bf06140190_0200
rows.name: To abandon that duty and go traveling...

rows.label: bf06140190_0210
rows.name: Is this...Wadatsumi's...?

rows.label: bf06140190_0220
rows.name:
A Driver who cannot even protect
himself is no Driver at all.

rows.label: bf06140190_0230
rows.name:
Yesterday's events have made me keenly
aware that I have no aptitude for it.

rows.label: bf06140190_0240
rows.name: You should have this.

rows.label: bf06140190_0250
rows.name: Majesty...

rows.label: bf06140190_0260
rows.name: The world is in the midst of great change.

rows.label: bf06140190_0270
rows.name:
You can see where it's headed
and be a great help to that boy.

rows.label: bf06140190_0280
rows.name: [ML:undisp ][ML:Dash ][ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf06140190_0290
rows.name:
I miss it, you know.
Lake Yuutle, in Gula.

rows.label: bf06140190_0300
rows.name: [ML:undisp ][ML:Dash ]え？

rows.label: bf06140190_0310
rows.name:
Remember when the two of us would shake
off the servants and go swimming there?

rows.label: bf06140190_0320
rows.name: Ah... Yes. Of course.

rows.label: bf06140190_0330
rows.name:
Kids from the nearby village
would come too. Good times.

rows.label: bf06140190_0340
rows.name: Majesty...

rows.label: bf06140190_0350
rows.name: If Superbia...

rows.label: bf06140190_0360
rows.name:
No, the whole of Alst could be like that
again... Wouldn't it be beautiful...?

rows.label: bf06140190_0370
rows.name: Is that my new duty, then?

rows.label: bf06140190_0380
rows.name:
In truth, it should have been you
sitting in this chair right now...

rows.label: bf06140190_0390
rows.name:
In Superbia, imperial succession
customarily passes to men.

rows.label: bf06140190_0400
rows.name:
On the day Your Majesty was born,
that's exactly what happened.

rows.label: bf06140190_0410
rows.name:
I've known all of this since I was
summoned to the imperial palace.

rows.label: bf06140190_0420
rows.name: That's why Father raised you as a man.

rows.label: bf06140190_0430
rows.name:
You, the child of his younger
brother, Duke Hendricks.

rows.label: bf06140190_0440
rows.name: And I am grateful for it.

rows.label: bf06140190_0450
rows.name:
Thanks to that, I met Kagutsuchi,
and I met them too.

rows.label: bf06140190_0460
rows.name: Nothing could be more fun.

rows.label: bf06140190_0470
rows.name: There. Those are your true feelings.

rows.label: bf06140190_0480
rows.name: [ML:undisp ][ML:Dash ]！

rows.label: bf06140190_0490
rows.name: A magnificent power resides in you.

rows.label: bf06140190_0500
rows.name: And power should be used the right way.

rows.label: bf06140190_0510
rows.name: Nefer...

rows.label: bf06140190_0520
rows.name: Isn't that enough now?

rows.label: bf06140190_0530
rows.name: Free yourself, Meleph Lahat.

rows.label: bf06140190_0540
rows.name:
I have no words. Thank
you, Your Majesty.

rows.label: bf06140190_0550
rows.name: Very well, then.

rows.label: bf06140190_0560
rows.name: I, Meleph, humbly accept this duty.

rows.label: bf06140190_0570
rows.name: Now that's my Meleph Lahat. I'm counting on you.
